items.docs: The active card sets anchor-name. The indicator uses position-anchor and inset: anchor(inside), and transitions inset for about 450ms with a slight overshoot. That path works in Chromium since mid-2024, Safari since September 2025, and Firefox 147 (January 2026). When CSS.supports('anchor-name: --x') is false, ResizeObserver and getBoundingClientRect place the same indicator. Each grid uses its own anchor name. With reduced motion the indicator moves without the stretch, and the call to action fades in without a slide. Answer no if the CLI asks to overwrite a primitive the host already has. The anchor-positioning idea is from jh3yy: https://x.com/jh3yy/status/2105823926978814273. This is an independent implementation.

items.docs: Clean-room parallax. No Motion UI or Motion+ source. Movement is translateY from use-scroll-progress, so the layout box does not shift. The first paint matches the server. Reduced motion, via motion-preference, holds every layer at rest. Answer no if the CLI asks to overwrite use-scroll-progress, motion-preference, or another file the host already has. The item ships no theme, cssVars, or fixed colors.

items.docs: Clean-room horizontal rail. No Motion UI or Motion+ source. On a wide screen with motion allowed, the pane fills the viewport and the section grows by the track overflow (ResizeObserver). Vertical scroll translates the track until the section end meets the bottom of that pane. Reduced motion, and viewports under minWidth, keep a native horizontal scroller with scroll-snap and the author pane height. Arrow keys move the rail. Focusable items scroll into view. Answer no if the CLI asks to overwrite button, use-scroll-progress, motion-preference, or another file the host already has. The item ships no theme, cssVars, or fixed colors.
